assessment_objectives.objective: remediation and mitigation of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) is prioritized.
KEV remediation efforts reduce or remove public exposure to exploitation, if applicable.
KEV remediation efforts expedite patch deployment actions, if applicable.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no later than the remediation due date published for the vulnerability in the applicable Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog
